headline: Transportation Commission to elect officers and review requests for Fair Share bus shelters and the Wobble Before You Gobble 5k road race.
summary: The commission will elect officers, review its ordinance and responsibilities, and discuss traffic and parking regulations. It will also consider requests for bus shelters, help with a 5k road race, and existing requests from the Traffic Commission.
